name: Alpine Hotel
description: Hotel Arven — a one-page site for a small Swiss hotel at the top of Zermatt: a hero whose photo band runs full-bleed as a booking card climbs into it, a pinned film that zooms and splits into cards, snowboard footage running inside the type, a rooms shelf, nearby spots by season, services, and a full booking form.
designedFor: Boutique hotels, chalets and mountain lodges that take bookings direct
Resorts that want rooms, nearby spots, services and a reservation form on one scrolling page
Studios pitching a hospitality brand with scroll-driven, cinematic motion
Anyone after a Lenis + Framer Motion page with pinned video and text-clipped footage
